facts.fact: UNCTAD's paper (September 2021) says the national ICT Policy and Strategy was developed in 2016 (FDRE 2016), is being implemented through listed interventions, and that its implementation is fragmented across projects and sectors.

The paper says that under the Communication Services Proclamation of 2019 the Ministry of Innovation and Technology is mandated to develop policy instruments, design programmes, mobilise resources and guide and monitor the telecom sector, with the Ethiopian Communications Authority regulating it.
